notes.title: We’re announcing a new game! 🐺🪓
notes.content:
[h2]✨ Hello, Fantasy Gamers! ✨[/h2][p]Today we’re bringing you news that will make you howl with delight:

[/p][h1][b]Introducing ‘[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4005230/"]Red Riding Hood on All Fours[/url]’![/b][/h1][previewyoutube="bgZXz1sc_78;full"][/previewyoutube][p]
The Little Red Riding Hood you knew has grown up and is no longer afraid of getting lost in the woods. In fact, now she gets lost on purpose! In her basket, aside from Grandma's lunch, she also carries a few things that make her trip more… entertaining… You know, normal stuff, like egg vibrators, butt plugs, sexy costumes... Her imagination (and lust!) is unending!

As Evan, the local lumberjack, you follow the same path every day, looking for new trees to cut down. Encounters with Little Red are inevitable so, will you secretly enjoy her dirty games, or give her something [i][b]else[/b][/i] to play with? 😏

[/p][h3]🐺 Strip her... to eat her better 🐺[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197692/a88fd0888841ab0eabd08f7605bbfebcc12ae0ec.gif"][/img][/p][h1]⭐️ Add ‘Little Red Riding Hood on All Fours’ to your wishlist! ⭐️[/h1][p]
Follow our developer homepage on Steam and follow Fantasy Games on [url="https://x.com/Fantasy_GStudio"]Twitter/X[/url] so you don't miss any releases.
Also, we invite you to join the Fantasy Games [url="https://discord.gg/52EWyeYRh5"]Discord[/url] server and comment on the new announcements with the development team!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45197692/419fcb4f6a341cccfb2c397434608b1fe07f4827.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]With love (and lust 🔥),
The Fantasy Games Team[/p]
